name: Kokujin VS Hakujin ~Power Sex no Toriko ni Natta Tsuma~
original_name: 黒人VS白人～パワーセックスの虜になった妻～
source:
The main character, Yuusuke Takamoto, was content with an ordinary but peaceful and contented life. He has been happily married to his beloved wife Miyuki for three years.

As a full-time housewife, Miyuki is a very supportive and devoted person. She has learned to cook from Nodoka Shinonome, a senior housewife who became her friend after moving into the apartment, and she has become very good at it. Yuusuke was grateful to Miyuki, saying that he had married the best woman he had ever met.

However, Yusuke felt bad that Miyuki, who is an active person by nature and likes to go out and work, is a full-time housewife. Then, a foreign student, Ben, comes to Nodoka's house.

Miyuki finds it stimulating to interact with Ben, who is black and grew up in a completely different culture from her own. She had not been a housewife for a long time and was delighted to be exposed to a new set of values.

Since Ben's arrival, Miyuki is as energetic as she used to be when she was working. Yusuke, too, was pleased to see his wife enjoying herself. Until he learned of his wife's infidelity with the black foreign student.

[From [url=https://www.pin-point.biz/38_srkr/story.html]official site[/url]
translation:
主角高本祐介过着平凡却安稳美满的生活，心中十分满足。他与深爱的妻子美由纪结婚已有三年，婚姻幸福。

美由纪是一名专职主妇，体贴贤惠，全心支持丈夫。搬进公寓后，她与经验丰富的主妇东云和花成了朋友，向对方学习厨艺，如今已经做得一手好菜。祐介对她满怀感激，觉得自己娶到了世上最好的女人。

不过，美由纪天生活泼，喜欢出门工作，却一直留在家中做主妇，这也让祐介有些过意不去。就在这时，一名外国留学生本来到和花家中。

本是黑人，在与美由纪截然不同的文化中长大。与他交流，让美由纪感到新鲜而刺激。成为主妇的时间还不长的她，很高兴能接触到全新的价值观。

自本到来后，美由纪恢复了从前工作时的活力。看到妻子如此开心，祐介也由衷高兴。直到他得知，妻子竟然与那名黑人留学生有了婚外情。
